multiple_comparison_policy: All computed comparisons saved, including missing/constant; no p-values, selected model, predictive target, significance or tradability claim.
chronology_policy: four equal elapsed-time quarters; availability counts and signs reported separately
dependence_policy: overlap counts retained; nearby controls can include other first-observed starts; no independent-sample inference
prestart_feature_change_policy: onset cohort ends strictly before start; separate contemporaneous onset association rows
source_preservation: alignment.sqlite is read only; complete raw source rows and all offsets remain pinned; numerical analyses cover documented selected measurements, not every byte of all payloads
